name: VLC Desktop Remote
description: Control a local or network VLC player with transport, seek, volume, status, and playlist controls.

options.label: VLC HTTP URL
options.help: Enable VLC Web Interface in the desktop app. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 for VLC on this PC.

options.label: VLC password
options.help: The password set in VLC Preferences > Main interfaces > Lua.

options.label: Refresh interval
options.help: How often the panel refreshes VLC status and playlist data.
